meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Resend 集成电子邮件通道，让 NanoClaw 能收发邮件。它会复制适配器、注册依赖、构建验证，并提示你配置邮箱凭证。
howto.when: 当你运行 NanoClaw 的安装流程，并选择添加 Resend 邮件通道时触发。需要你手动在 Resend 网站创建账号、验证域名、设置 API 密钥和 webhook。

say.text: 帮我添加 Resend 邮件通道，连接到我的邮箱。
say.note: Claude 会开始复制适配器并提示你输入凭证。

say.text: 设置我的邮箱为所有者，并发送一封欢迎邮件。
say.note: Claude 会注册你的邮箱并发送测试邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude integrates an email channel via Resend, enabling NanoClaw to send and receive emails. It copies the adapter, registers dependencies, builds, and prompts for credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run NanoClaw's setup flow and choose to add the Resend email channel. Requires manual steps: create a Resend account, verify a domain, set up API key and webhook.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel and connect it to my inbox.
say_en.note: Claude will copy the adapter and prompt for credentials.

say_en.text: Set my email as owner and send a welcome email.
say_en.note: Claude will register your email and send a test message.
